name: Wintermute USDC Select
oneLiner: armUSDCs is Wintermute's USDC lending vault on Ethereum; shares redeem at NAV when liquidity is available and bear strategy losses.
collateral: USDC lender positions in eight Morpho markets secured by cbBTC, WBTC, wstETH, PT-reUSD-10DEC2026, PT-USDat-14JAN2027, PT-USD3-17DEC2026, Wildcat v-wmtUSDC, 3Jane USD3 collateral
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares accrue lending interest and realize losses against USDC; direct redemption uses idle USDC and a configured liquidity adapter, subject to market liquidity. A separate in-kind redemption route retains underlying lending-position exposure; forceDeallocate itself withdraws available cash to the vault. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Wintermute USDC Select is an ERC-4626 share over USDC with a pro-rata claim on Morpho lending positions, bearing losses and liquidity constraints. At Ethereum block 26197390 (2026-10-15T10:43:11Z), totalSupply=45777319351152393341737589 atomic 18-decimal shares; totalAssets and accrueInterestView assets=46779493778612 atomic 6-decimal USDC, with zero pending fee shares and zero idle USDC. The sole adapter enumerates seven invested markets whose expectedSupplyAssets sum exactly to totalAssets. convertToAssets(1e18)=1021892 USDC atomic units. The native lending claim supports protocol-position rather than the fiat-cash parent's archetype. Morpho creationTimestamp=1776879155 and deployment receipt at block 24936985 establish 2026-04-22 launch. Published VaultV2 audits concern framework code, not exact-vault financial assurance.

notices.title: Curator terms restrict UK and US access
notices.message: Armitage's terms, last updated 19 May 2026, prohibit UK and US persons from using Covered Vaults. Permissionless contract execution does not waive these contractual restrictions. The terms identify Corto Industries Limited in the Cayman Islands as curator, disclaim CIMA supervision and do not guarantee withdrawal timing.
